#  Simulation séquentielle d’un pont Brownien 

##  Fonction `simulate_wiener_bridge` 

```{r}

simulate_wiener_bridge <- function(X, digits = 3) {
  
  t_obs <- X[, 1]
  x_obs <- X[, 2]
  
  if (length(t_obs) != length(x_obs)) {
    stop("t_obs et x_obs doivent avoir la même longueur.")
  }
  if (length(t_obs) < 2) {
    stop("Il faut au moins 2 observations.")
  }
  
  params <- estimer_wiener(t_obs, x_obs)
  sigma <- params["sigma"]
  
  grille <- construire_grille_dec(t_obs, digits)
  
  delta <- grille$pas_fine
  
  t_fine <- grille$t_fine
  idx_obs <- grille$idx_obs
  n_fine <- grille$n_fine
  n_obs <- grille$n_obs
  
  X_fine <- numeric(n_fine)
  X_fine[idx_obs] <- x_obs
  
  for (i in 1:(n_obs - 1)) {
    idx_start <- idx_obs[i]
    idx_end <- idx_obs[i + 1]
    
    t_start <- t_fine[idx_start]
    t_end <- t_fine[idx_end]
    
    x_start <- x_obs[i]
    x_end <- x_obs[i + 1]
    
    K <- idx_end - idx_start
    
    if (K >= 2) {
      X_current <- x_start
      
      for (k in 0:(K - 2)) {
        s_k <- t_start + k * delta
        s_kp1 <- s_k + delta
        
        mean_cond <- X_current + (delta / (t_end - s_k)) * (x_end - X_current)
        var_cond <- sigma^2 * delta * (t_end - s_kp1) / (t_end - s_k)
        
        X_next <- rnorm(1, mean = mean_cond, sd = sqrt(var_cond))
        
        X_fine[idx_start + k + 1] <- X_next
        X_current <- X_next
      }
    }
    
    X_fine[idx_end] <- x_end
  }
  
  return(list(
    t_fine = t_fine,
    X_fine = X_fine,
    idx_obs = idx_obs,
    grille = grille,
    sigma_estime = sigma
  ))
}
```

## Application  1 : Inspection régulières

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(46)

t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = 50) 

vrais_mu <- 2
vrais_sigma <- 1

obs <- simulate_wiener_rwa(
  times = t_obs,
  mu = vrais_mu,
  sigma = vrais_sigma,
  nsim = 1
)

x_obs <- as.vector(obs)
t_obs <- as.numeric(rownames(obs))

print(head(data.frame(t = t_obs, X = x_obs)))

estimation <- estimer_wiener(t_obs, x_obs)

cat("Paramètres :")
cat("  Vrais : mu =", vrais_mu, ", sigma =", vrais_sigma, "\n")
cat("  Estimés : mu =", estimation["mu"], ", sigma =", estimation["sigma"], "\n")

X <- cbind(t_obs, x_obs)

resultat <- simulate_wiener_bridge(X = X, digits = 3)

df_traj <- data.frame(t = resultat$t_fine, X = resultat$X_fine, Type = "Trajectoire simulee")
df_obs <- data.frame(t = t_obs, X = x_obs, Type = "Observations")

df_combined <- rbind(df_traj, df_obs)
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = df_traj, aes(x = t, y = X, color = "Trajectoire simulee"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(x = t, y = X, color = "Observations"), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Legende", 
                     values = c("Trajectoire simulee" = "blue", "Observations" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Pont brownien - Processus de Wiener avec derive",
    x = "Temps t", y = "X(t)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
